article_title: Why I don't always tell potential employers I'm dyslexic
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level B; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What central issue does the article examine?
options: Why many dyslexic people hide their condition at work and what support could help
How schools diagnose every child with dyslexia
Why written applications should replace interviews
tasks.correct_answer: Why many dyslexic people hide their condition at work and what support could help
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בסיבות להסתרת דיסלקסיה במקום העבודה ובתמיכה ובהתאמות שיכולות להסיר חסמים.

tasks.prompt: What proportion of surveyed dyslexic adults said they hide their dyslexia at work?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בסקר של אגודת הדיסלקסיה הבריטית, 46% אמרו שהם מסתירים את הדיסלקסיה בעבודה.

tasks.prompt: How did dyslexia affect nurse Lisa Daniels before she received support?
options: She left work more than an hour late on most days to finish paperwork
She refused to use any written documents
She was unable to work with patients
tasks.correct_answer: She left work more than an hour late on most days to finish paperwork
tasks.explanation_hebrew: דניאלס נשארה יותר משעה אחרי העבודה ברוב הימים כדי לסיים את הניירת.

tasks.prompt: What does “daunting” mean when Bailey describes the application process?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה daunting מתאר תהליך שמפחיד וקשה להתמודד איתו.

tasks.prompt: What workplace adjustment helped Daniels after she joined a neurodiversity staff network?
options: A permanent assistant for every task
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לאחר שקיבלה יותר ביטחון ותמיכה, אחת ההתאמות שניתנו לה הייתה אוזניות מבטלות רעש.

tasks.prompt: Why might written applications and timed tests disadvantage dyslexic candidates?
options: They allow too much time for preparation
They emphasise forms of performance that may not reveal candidates' knowledge and strengths
They require every candidate to disclose a diagnosis
tasks.correct_answer: They emphasise forms of performance that may not reveal candidates' knowledge and strengths
tasks.explanation_hebrew: תהליכים שמבוססים על כתיבה ומבחנים בזמן עלולים למדוד קושי מסוים במקום את הידע, היצירתיות והיכולות של המועמד.

tasks.prompt: Give three findings from the British Dyslexia Association survey or report.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה נתונים מדויקים: 46% מסתירים דיסלקסיה, 81% מדווחים על לחץ בעבודה, יותר ממחצית מרגישים רע עם עצמם, 39% חוו קושי נפשי, או הערכה של 3.3 מיליון עובדים דיסלקטים.
expected_points: 46% said they hide their dyslexia at work.
81% said dyslexia adds to work-related stress.
More than half said it makes them feel bad about themselves.
The BDA estimates 3.3 million dyslexic adults are in employment.

tasks.prompt: Why did joining the neurodiversity staff network change Daniels's experience?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהרשת נתנה לה מידע, תחושת שייכות וביטחון לבקש התאמות, כגון אוזניות מבטלות רעש, לאחר שהמנהל הקודם דחה את בקשותיה.
expected_points: A colleague connected her with a network where neurodiversity could be discussed openly.
The network helped her confidence grow after a manager had dismissed her needs.
She gained practical adjustments, including noise-cancelling headphones.
Support helped her build resilience and recover from imposter syndrome.

tasks.prompt: Write 3–4 sentences explaining how employers could make recruitment and work more inclusive for dyslexic people.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע הכשרת מנהלים, התאמות גם ללא אבחון, חלופות למבחנים כתובים בזמן, מסמכים נגישים ודרכים שונות להציג יכולות.
expected_points: Train managers to understand dyslexia and respond constructively.
Offer reasonable adjustments based on need, even when a formal diagnosis is unavailable.
Provide alternatives to heavily written applications and timed tests.
Use accessible fonts, colours and communication methods, and let candidates demonstrate strengths in different ways.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Bailey's and Daniels's experiences and the wider workplace problem in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את חשש ביילי מחשיפה, הקשיים בראיונות, חוויית דניאלס עם ניירת ומנהל לא תומך, השיפור לאחר התאמות והמלצות ה־BDA.
expected_points: Bailey sometimes withholds her dyslexia because she fears it may reduce her chances of selection.
Applications and interviews make her anxious, although she sees creativity and visual thinking as strengths.
Daniels worked late to finish paperwork and initially received little support for requested adjustments.
A neurodiversity network and practical support helped Daniels gain confidence and resilience.
The BDA says inaccessible systems create stress and calls for reasonable adjustments and better-trained managers.
